title: Python for Absolute Beginners Workshop
venue: CS Lab 03, Academic Block 2, CUI Wah
target_audience: 1st and 2nd semester CS/SE/AI students with zero coding background
fee: Free for registered CUI Wah students
prerequisites: Bring your laptop with Python 3.11+ installed (or follow our setup guide)
description: A hands-on, zero-stress introduction to Python variables, loops, functions, and logic building. Refreshments and certificates provided for all active attendees.

title: Interactive Prompt & Context Engineering Bootcamp
venue: Main Auditorium & Computing Lab 01, CUI Wah
target_audience: All undergraduate computing students eager to master modern Generative AI
instructor: GDGoC CUI Wah Core AI Team
prerequisites: Basic curiosity about AI; Google AI Studio account setup
description: Two intensive days of prompt engineering, few-shot conditioning, structured JSON generation, token budgeting, mini-RAG architecture, and live Gemini API calls.

title: Wah SpeedCode Hackathon 2026
venue: Student Activity Center (SAC), Ground Floor, CUI Wah
target_audience: Teams of 2 to 4 students from any semester or department
fee: PKR 500 per team (covers meals, swag bags, and energy drinks)
prerequisites: At least one team member proficient in Web, Mobile, or Python development
description: 12-hour high-energy hackathon solving real campus and community problems using AI, IoT, and cloud technologies. Cash prizes for Top 3 winning teams!

title: Git & GitHub Essentials for First-Semester Devs
description: Learn version control without panic: git init, add, commit, push, pull, resolving merge conflicts, and publishing your first GitHub repository.

title: Annual Inter-Departmental Futsal Cup 2026
venue: CUI Wah Campus Sports Ground & Futsal Court
target_audience: All registered CUI Wah departmental teams (CS, EE, ME, BBA)
prerequisites: Proper sports gear and departmental sports coordinator sign-off
description: 3-day knockout futsal championship. Trophies, medals, and campus bragging rights for the champion department!

title: Central Cafeteria & Library Renovation Notice
venue: Central Student Cafeteria (Block C) & Main Campus Library (2nd Floor)
target_audience: All campus students, faculty, and visiting staff
description: The Central Cafeteria will operate with a temporary outdoor food kiosk near Block B during maintenance. The Main Library study hall remains open, but the digital reading room is temporarily relocated to Seminar Room A.
